limitations: Reproduction uses real installed DeepSpeed forward/backward and Accelerate DeepSpeed backward wrapper with CPU-only device/distributed scaffolding and SGD; not a full GPU ZeRO replay.

The bug applies to every affected training run through this entry with gradient accumulation >1, including sam; it is not unique to all.
Changing the trainer affects newly started processes; saved weights and already-running processes are not retroactively repaired.
Training metrics still report the last microbatch of an update; logging was not changed in this fix.
